children: A Spanish campground solar system using Tigo equipment reported 4,854 kWh of Reclaimed Energy from July through October 2026, about 25% of monitored PV production. Projected annual diesel-fuel savings are €55.0K versus the previous annual bill; no prior-period production comparison was provided.
The project is expected to reduce the campground's approximately €70.0K annual diesel bill by about 79%; savings are projected, not reported as realized.
This is 25% of 19,454 kWh monitored PV production over the period; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Provides a concrete customer deployment, but the release gives no project value or direct revenue to Tigo.

This is an early customer case study demonstrating Tigo equipment in a Spanish commercial and industrial solar installation, rather than a company-wide financial update. Broader significance would require additional deployments, quantified revenue or orders for Tigo, or evidence that projected customer savings are sustained.
